## Checklist

- [ ] `composer test`, `composer analyse` and `composer lint` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has a test; a fix has a test that failed before it
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.ru.md` are updated if what is converted, the HTML it produces, or an option changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased` if users can notice the change
- [ ] Changes to the DOCX writer were opened in Microsoft Word (say which version), or say why not
